description: What Jest 30.5.2 prints under a console entry (B23a): a `console.error` made in a helper function, a direct `console.warn` and a `console.log`. `warn` and `error` get a code frame and every frame outside Jest, the helper's and the test's; `log` gets its first frame alone. Under the default reporter (the title at 4 spaces, the frames at 6). One Jest worker. A black-box run.
